info.description:
Cloud-native Manufacturing Execution System API for phygital fabrication.
Provides endpoints for order management, task/Kanban board operations,
machine control, telemetry, quality management, and real-time updates.

A job consumption, receipt or count line in a unit with no conversion to its stock item's unit is recorded but moves no stock ("needs conversion"). Adding the conversion (POST /v1/inventory/materials/{id}/conversions) posts it and marks the gap resolved; a newer fact of the same job marks an older gap superseded.
get.summary: Quantities waiting for a unit conversion

get.description: Newest first, without lines (line_count says how many).

post.description: is_opening marks the tenant's one opening count (ruling I7; 409 opening_count_exists for a second).

get.summary: Get a physical count with its lines

post.description: For each line: result matched (no difference), adjusted (an 'adjustment' movement of counted minus expected, reference_type inventory_count, reference_id the line), needs_conversion (no conversion to the stock item's unit: no movement, a conversion gap is listed and posted once the conversion exists) or not_stocked (the material has no stock item). Count differences are never folded into a job. Idempotent: closing a closed count returns it with already_closed true and moves nothing. Expected is the stock at counted_at plus count adjustments posted after it by lines counted at or before it. An older count never closes over a newer one: when another closed count has a line for the same material counted later, 409 newer_count_exists lists the materials. Each applied line reports movements_since_counted and quantity_since_counted (movements between counted_at and the close). Needs the admin or inventory_manager role.

One line per material: recording the same material again replaces its quantity, unit and counted_at while the count is open. counted_at (default now) is when the material was counted; closing compares with the stock on hand at that moment.

get.description: Registry entries ordered by code, each with its stock item (inventory_item_id, stock_sku, stock_unit, quantity_on_hand) when it has one. Quantities only.

parameters.description: filament, resin, sheet, spare_part, consumable, packaging or other
parameters.name: category

post.description: Codes are 1-64 letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-' (starting with a letter or digit), unique per tenant ignoring case, and never change. A code equal to an alias or a linked item's SKU is refused, and so is an unlinked item's SKU unless inventory_item_id is that item: then the code is registered and the item linked in one transaction. Needs the admin or inventory_manager role.

get.description: Stock items with no registry entry (with the reason the migration left them: sku_is_not_a_valid_code, unit_is_not_a_valid_unit, sku_differs_from_another_only_in_case, code_registered_for_another_material, not_linked), batch lots with no stock item, and consumption material codes that resolve to no registry entry. Nothing here is guessed: a person registers, links or aliases each one. At most 500 of each.

post.description: For a code consumption already uses (a print profile's material type, a lot's product code). Consumption recorded from then on resolves to the material; stock already relieved, or not, is not re-settled. The alias must not already name a material (code, alias or linked SKU).
post.summary: Name a material by another code

post.description: 1 from_unit = factor to_unit (for example 1 spool = 1000 g). kg↔g, l↔ml, m↔mm and cm↔mm are built in (409 conversion_builtin). One factor per unit pair in either direction (409 conversion_exists); conversions never change. In the same transaction, every quantity of this material waiting for a conversion (job consumption relief, receipts, count lines) is posted when the new conversion makes it convertible: gaps_resolved and stock_movements say what moved.
post.summary: Add a unit conversion for a material

get.description: Newest received first. from inclusive, to exclusive, on received_at.

400.description: invalid_material_id, invalid_invoice_status, invalid_status, invalid_from, invalid_to, invalid_limit or invalid_offset

post.description: Records a registered, active material that has a stock item. received_at defaults to now. The lot is batch_lot_id (linked to the material's stock item when it has none; 409 lot_belongs_to_other_item otherwise) or lot_number (found, or created for this item). When the unit converts to the stock item's unit (same unit, kg↔g, l↔ml, m↔mm, cm↔mm, or the material's conversion), a 'receipt' movement (reference_type inventory_receipt) raises stock and status is posted; otherwise status is needs_conversion, stock is untouched and a conversion gap is listed. idempotency_key (1-100 characters) is required: a retry with the same key and request returns the first receipt with 200 and replayed true; the same key with another request is 409 idempotency_key_reused. Needs a person with the admin or inventory_manager role (403 otherwise).

get.description: Per-job consumption rows, quantities only (no cost): material (g, mm, ml, sheet) and machine time (min), each with basis (actual or estimate) and source (printer, operator or slicer). engagement_slug is the order's current engagement. registry_code is the material registry code material_code resolves to (omitted when unregistered). Rows are ordered by occurred_at (the job's completion); from is inclusive and to exclusive.

parameters.description: Filter by the order's engagement slug
parameters.name: engagement_slug

get.description: The RFC 0058 wave 1 gate is that every material consumption row carries a material registry code. A row's code resolves at read time: the code itself, an alias, or a linked stock item's SKU. Counts material rows (occurred_at in [from, to) when given) with and without a registry code, and lists the unresolved codes, most rows first (at most 200). Register, alias or link each one; nothing is guessed.

post.description: Creates a new order in received status. Items may be supplied inline; each becomes an order item, and when orders.auto_decompose is enabled every item also spawns a production task (with capability-based machine auto-assignment when orders.auto_assign is enabled). Without items the response is the bare order; with items it is {order, items, tasks_created}. engagement_slug, when given, must match ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,62}$ (400 invalid_engagement_slug otherwise).

parameters.description: Order creation data (optionally with inline items and shipping_address)
parameters.name: body

201.description: Created order (or {order, items, tasks_created} when inline items were supplied)

get.description: Returns a single order with all details

put.description: Updates order fields including status. Status accepts the canonical enum values (received, validated, scheduled, in_progress, completed, shipped, cancelled); legacy aliases (confirmed, processing, in_production, quality_check, ready, delivered) are normalized onto them. Unknown statuses are rejected with 400. A status change publishes order.status_changed. engagement_slug sets the engagement ("" clears it; omitted leaves it unchanged) and must match ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,62}$.

400.description: Validation error, invalid status or invalid engagement_slug

Records an operator-reported actual (basis actual, source operator) for a task: material with material_code and unit g, mm, ml or sheet, or machine time with unit min. It belongs to the task's latest completed dispatch when there is one. When material_code is the SKU of an inventory item in the same unit, stock relieved for the job is brought to this actual (an adjustment against the slicer estimate already relieved). The same actual can be reported once per job and material (409 already_recorded).
Changes task status and position, triggers automation for machine jobs

movements_since_counted.description: Movements recorded between counted_at and the close.

engagement_slug.description: EngagementSlug is read from the order at query time (List only).

registry_code.description:
RegistryCode is the material registry code material_code resolves to
(the code itself, an alias, or a linked item's SKU), read at query
time; empty when the code is not registered (List only).

inventory_item_id.description: The stock item linked to the material (none until one is linked).

stock_quantity.description: StockQuantity is Quantity in the stock item's unit, once posted.

material_code.description:
MaterialCode is required for material (unit g, mm, ml or sheet): the
inventory SKU when the material is stocked. Omit it for machine time
(unit min).

engagement_slug.description:
EngagementSlug attributes the order to an engagement
(^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,62}$). Optional.

inventory_item_id.description: The stock item linked to the material (none until one is linked).

InventoryItemID links this unlinked stock item to the new material in
the same transaction (required when the code is that item's SKU).

engagement_slug.description:
EngagementSlug sets the order's engagement when present; "" clears it
and an absent field leaves it unchanged.

EngagementSlug attributes the order to an engagement (one slug shared
across the ecosystem). Empty when unattributed. Backed by
orders.engagement_slug (migration 033); see ValidEngagementSlug.

shipping_address.description:
ShippingAddress holds delivery details as free-form JSON
(e.g. line1, line2, city, state, postal_code, country, contact_name,
contact_phone). Backed by orders.shipping_address (migration 025).
